infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Workstream uses the microphone to capture site-walk dictation.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Workstream uses the camera to photograph site features for measurement.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Workstream attaches photos from your library to project measurements.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Workstream uses your location to pre-fill site addresses while you're on site.
